description: remoteContentTransition only appends an undo-ledger entry when a peer's content snapshot actually changed something; short-circuiting it always (the pre-fix behaviour, commit 854ae28) drops the neighbor's edit from the local undo journal again -- a local undo would silently discard it, the exact regression R4's tail names.
expectedKillingTests: records a peer world-sync content edit in the local ledger, so undo reverts specifically it
